procedure.action: Soak the specimen and its holder for 4 h at 20 +/- 1 C; log air and part temperature every 10 min.
outputs: environment log with an explicit UTC offset

procedure.action: Check the instruments before the acquisition: the scanner scans GS-25.4; the CMM probes GS-25.4 at 25 points. Retain every check.
procedure.check: each artifact reading lies within 2 U of its certificate value, U from the declared instrument uncertainty; otherwise stop and recalibrate

procedure.action: Locate the specimen in FX-321 (3-2-1 nest); clamp; probe datum A (3 points), B (2 points) and C (1 point) with the CMM and build the PART frame (datum_frame_321).
Measure the six registration targets RT1-RT6 with the CMM in the PART frame and export them as the cmm capture.
Set the scanner to the declared 100 mm standoff; scan both raster passes at the native spacing, rejecting points with incidence above 30 deg.
outputs: native point cloud of each pass with the scanner settings

procedure.action: Repeat steps 3, 4 and 5 twice more, removing the specimen from FX-321 and re-seating it between repeats (replicates of the target measurement and both raster passes).
outputs: two further replicates (replicates of the target measurement and both raster passes)

procedure.action: Register each pass of every replicate to the targets (Kabsch) and retain the transform and its residual.
procedure.check: registration residual consistent with chi-square(3N - 6) at the declared noise
outputs: registration transform and residual per pass

procedure.action: Fit the as-built dome on the 4 mm grid; fit the crest curvature in the T129 windows at full density.
outputs: fit parameters, covariance, residual map and outlier count

procedure.action: Report the fitted parameters with their covariance and the chi2 / dof model test (H1) before any tape is laid.
outputs: as-built dome record for MFG-COUPON-01, T138 and T140

procedure.action: Check the instruments after the acquisition: the scanner scans GS-25.4; the CMM probes GS-25.4 at 25 points. Retain every check.
procedure.check: each artifact reading lies within 2 U of its certificate value, U from the declared instrument uncertainty; otherwise stop and recalibrate

procedure.action: Retain every raw file, replicate and instrument check with its T139 retention record (ciw.lab-measurement-retention.v1).
outputs: retained raw data and retention records

purpose: Identify the as-built dome (height, width, centre) with its covariance and test the Gaussian model before the coupon separations of MFG-COUPON-01 are predicted and compared.

raw_formats.coordinates: CAD (model) frame through the declared PART -> CAD placement
raw_formats.header: lines '# key: value' for schema, protocol, instrument, frame, unit, origin; unit mm; origin measurement or synthetic (a synthetic capture starts with '# SYNTHETIC CAPTURE - NOT A MEASUREMENT')
raw_formats.uncertainty: u_mm is the declared standard uncertainty of each row (positive); for targets, of each coordinate in the common frame, including the registration of its image set

raw_formats.frame: scanner, registered to PART by the targets
raw_formats.reader: none yet: T129 fits synthetic scans only; a reader that runs fit_dome on a bound scan is open work
raw_formats.schema: native point cloud per pass: x_mm, y_mm, z_mm, incidence_deg, flag

required_raw_data: raw camera images (lossless) with exposure metadata and SHA-256 digests
tracker/CMM native point files with instrument serial and firmware
calibration certificates of scale bars, gauge sphere and step gauge (digest and validity window)
frame-chain transforms with covariances as computed at the time of measurement
environment log: air and part temperature, humidity, time-stamped with an explicit UTC offset
operator, fixture and specimen identities; clock source and synchronization method

scan_plan.filtering: reject points above the incidence limit or flagged by the scanner; no smoothing before either fit; reject fit residuals beyond 5 sigma and report their count

instrument_setup.passes: two orthogonal raster passes over x in [-60, 140], y in [-100, 100] mm
instrument_setup.scanner: laser line scanner (declared 0.01 mm point noise, 0.05 mm native spacing)

retained_raw_data: native point clouds of both passes with scanner settings and SHA-256 digests
target coordinates from the CMM and the scanner
fit parameters, covariance, residual map and outlier count

consumers: MFG-COUPON-01 (T128): the as-built coupon under the tapes
surface_fit.covariance: sigma^2 (J^T J)^-1 plus the declared scanner scale term on height and width and the target registration term on the centre
surface_fit.method: Gauss-Newton least squares from the nominal dome
surface_fit.model: z = z0 + a_x x + a_y y + h exp(-((x - x0)^2 + (y - y0)^2) / (2 sigma^2))

scan_plan.targets: six sphere-mounted targets off the dome, measured by the CMM in the PART frame and by the scanner
